en.text: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

zhSimplified.text: 我劝你，第一要为万人恳求、祷告、代求、祝谢；

zhTraditional.text: 我勸你，第一要為萬人懇求、禱告、代求、祝謝；

en.text: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

zhSimplified.text: 为君王和一切在位的，也该如此，使我们可以敬虔、端正、平安无事地度日。

zhTraditional.text: 為君王和一切在位的，也該如此，使我們可以敬虔、端正、平安無事地度日。

en.text: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

zhSimplified.text: 这是好的，在 神我们救主面前可蒙悦纳。

zhTraditional.text: 這是好的，在上帝我們救主面前可蒙悅納。

en.text: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

zhSimplified.text: 他愿意万人得救，明白真道。

zhTraditional.text: 他願意萬人得救，明白真道。

en.text: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

zhSimplified.text: 因为只有一位 神，在 神和人中间，只有一位中保，乃是降世为人的基督耶稣；

zhTraditional.text: 因為只有一位上帝，在上帝和人中間，只有一位中保，乃是降世為人的基督耶穌；

en.text: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

zhSimplified.text: 他舍自己作万人的赎价，到了时候，这事必证明出来。

zhTraditional.text: 他捨自己作萬人的贖價，到了時候，這事必證明出來。

en.text: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

zhSimplified.text: 我为此奉派作传道的，作使徒，作外邦人的师傅，教导他们相信，学习真道。我说的是真话，并不是谎言。

zhTraditional.text: 我為此奉派作傳道的，作使徒，作外邦人的師傅，教導他們相信，學習真道。我說的是真話，並不是謊言。

en.text: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

zhSimplified.text: 我愿男人无忿怒，无争论，举起圣洁的手，随处祷告；

zhTraditional.text: 我願男人無忿怒，無爭論，舉起聖潔的手，隨處禱告；

en.text: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

footnotes.text: 2:9 The word for “not” is the negative particle “μη” which denies an expected idea, as opposed to the usual word for “not” (ου) which denies a fact. Thus “μη” in this context is denying an expected idea (that women can be properly dressed without good works).

zhSimplified.text: 又愿女人廉耻、自守，以正派衣裳为妆饰，不以编发、黄金、珍珠，和贵价的衣裳为妆饰，

zhTraditional.text: 又願女人廉恥、自守，以正派衣裳為妝飾，不以編髮、黃金、珍珠，和貴價的衣裳為妝飾，

en.text: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

zhSimplified.text: 只要有善行，这才与自称是敬 神的女人相宜。

zhTraditional.text: 只要有善行，這才與自稱是敬上帝的女人相宜。

en.text: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

zhSimplified.text: 女人要沉静学道，一味地顺服。

zhTraditional.text: 女人要沉靜學道，一味地順服。

en.text: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

zhSimplified.text: 我不许女人讲道，也不许她辖管男人，只要沉静。

zhTraditional.text: 我不許女人講道，也不許她轄管男人，只要沉靜。

en.text: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

zhSimplified.text: 因为先造的是亚当，后造的是夏娃，

zhTraditional.text: 因為先造的是亞當，後造的是夏娃，

en.text: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

zhSimplified.text: 且不是亚当被引诱，乃是女人被引诱，陷在罪里。

zhTraditional.text: 且不是亞當被引誘，乃是女人被引誘，陷在罪裏。

en.text: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

zhSimplified.text: 然而，女人若常存信心、爱心，又圣洁自守，就必在生产上得救。

zhTraditional.text: 然而，女人若常存信心、愛心，又聖潔自守，就必在生產上得救。
